Source indicates these actions disappear below md, potentially preventing invoice selection and downstream work on mobile.

Bucket table omits line count/share at line 870; uninvoiced table omits narrative at line 906. No expansion or mobile detail configuration is present.

accessibility.detail: Energy threshold (>5%) and signed money use fixed amber/rose/emerald classes; numeric deltas provide non-color text. Effective contrast on light/dark/custom themes, badge severity, small buttons and dynamic share bar cannot be proved from source.

observed.detail: Domain panel derives source state, preserves shell, supplies source retry, retains content on stale and can render summaries during loading/empty/fatal states. SourceContent provides polite retained status and nonblocking retry.
Source enablement follows vehicle/invoice prerequisites; summaries distinguish Selection required, Source unavailable, Not computed and retained/loading states.

Loading buttons, inline MutationError and hook toasts; create selects returned invoice and closes import, dispute success closes editor, confirmed delete clears active ID before mutation. No success or failure exercised.
Nullable measured/expected values render dashes; source freshness is explicitly unknown without observedAt, client load time is separate. Money formatter distinguishes missing/nonfinite from zero.

issues.detail: Refresh failure, age staleness and paused/offline source all collapse to retained and SourceContent's generic recovery message. Adapter does not forward refreshError or isRefreshBlocked context; retained data is correctly kept.
issues.fix: Reuse SourceContent.retainedMessage and existing DataState fields to explain source-specific stale/offline/refresh-error distinctions without replacing retained data or creating a parallel state engine.

issues.detail: Quality sample_count falls back to zero whereas coverage renders unknown as a dash. If a partial runtime payload omits sample_count, unknown appears measured as zero. Types alone do not prove that this malformed/partial payload can occur.
issues.fix: Render missing/nonfinite sample counts as unavailable while retaining genuine zero; verify source contract before changing valid returned values.

visualIssues.detail: Three page class lines use fixed pure-white-derived borders/backgrounds at 604, 959 and 1013, including digest decoration. EvidencePanel.tsx:129 repeats fixed-white evidence cards. These are theme-dependent noise risks, not measured screenshot failures.
visualIssues.fix: Replace fixed-white surface/border decoration with existing neutral tokens; retain digest legibility and all line/history/evidence information.

visualIssues.detail: Share bar uses fixed amber-400/70; digest uses cyan-300 with raw text-sm at 963; metadata uses raw text-xs at 262/403. Financial variance colors at 350 and bucket amount at 386 have semantic purpose but fixed saturation merits restraint, especially light themes. No literal neon or glow/shadow classes found in assigned page.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse semantic severity and typography roles; reserve accent emphasis for actionable variance rather than the opaque digest. Keep dynamic share width and signed values. Do not reset user theme preferences.

visualIssues.detail: Evidence limitations combine fixed amber border/background with amber/cyan icons at lines 64, 120 and 166. Semantic caution is valid; saturation and theme contrast remain visually unverified.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse existing subdued semantic warning/information styling in the domain evidence owner, retaining explicit unsupported caveats.

architectureIssues.detail: activeInvoice is independent local state. Changing selected vehicle refetches the list at line 88, but reportQuery remains keyed only by activeInvoice at line 89; no page reset or membership check exists. A displayed report can therefore retain a previous vehicle's invoice context. Similarly, open dispute state/reasons are not bound to an invoice identity when Audit changes selection at line 220.
architectureIssues.fix: Review and explicitly bind selected report/editor identity to invoice and vehicle scope, preserving unsaved notes safely and preventing claims from silently switching targets. Do not infer a server authorization flaw or execute financial writes to test this.

architectureIssues.detail: Only 50 invoices at offset 0 are loaded; no server next-page controller is present. Invoice export correctly states loaded-only scope at lines 704-711. DataTable client pagination must not be represented as full server coverage.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve loaded-only export disclosure; separately assess a typed server-pagination extension if complete statement navigation is required. Do not claim all statements or reinterpret server totals.

architectureIssues.detail: Large 1059-line orchestration includes four column definitions and two editors. Existing domain adapters already avoid competing systems. Raw reason/status prettification at 365 and 985, plus VerdictBadge.tsx:68, is not localized vocabulary.
architectureIssues.fix: Extract feature-owned editors/column preparation only if needed, retaining total section/action coverage; route known enum labels through existing localization while keeping unknown source text intact. Do not invent a new status registry.

dataBehavior: Currencies remain statement-specific ISO-4217 minor units; formatCurrencyMinor respects locale and currency fraction digits. Invoice table uses each row's own currency.
Wh and seconds remain canonical raw wire/filter/export values; useUnits formats energy only at display boundaries. MoneyInput edits integer minor amounts, not major units.
Reconciliation matching, confidence, signed variance, recoverability and causal attribution remain returned-source decisions; no new tolerance/cost calculations.
Eight summary metrics: billed total, expected total, net variance, disputable amount, matched lines, unmatched lines, billed energy and energy variance with measured-energy context.

Invoice export fields remain invoice_ref/provider/period_start/period_end/billed_total_minor/currency/line_count/status; export all loaded items independent of visible columns/search as currently disclosed.

Other table exports retain current callback scope and source fields, including match confidence, measured energy, time delta, recoverability/reasons, category shares and uninvoiced narratives; no claim of unseen/full-server rows.
Preserve statement billing dates as independent business dates, not header workspace date selection. Keep local datetime ISO round trip and UTC date-input semantics.
Null arrays default to empty; unknown nullable measurements show dashes rather than zero. Draft zero defaults are editable inputs, not measured telemetry.
Keep existing query keys, enablement, AbortSignal forwarding, ownership invalidation and inherited retry/cache policies; preserve confirmed deletion and mutation feedback.

Dispute packet digest and recorded claimed/recovered amounts, opened time, notes and status remain visible. Explicit unsupported caveats retain prepared-not-sent provider boundary and tax/idle legality limits.
Preserve quality status/reasons/sample counts/coverage/window, evidence source/summary/sample count/observed time and limitations; do not invent absent source metadata.
Table IDs ownership-reconcile-invoices/lines/buckets/uninvoiced and existing preference/localization/unit formatting ownership remain stable.
